description: This file defines types, functions, and registration mechanisms for sandbox backends in a software project, including backend factory registration, retrieval, and management for different sandbox implementations like Docker and SSH.

methods.name: normalizeSandboxBackendId
methods.description: Normalizes a sandbox backend ID by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: registerSandboxBackend
methods.description: Registers a sandbox backend factory and optional manager under a given ID.

methods.name: getSandboxBackendFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory function for a given sandbox backend ID.

methods.name: getSandboxBackendManager
methods.description: Retrieves the manager for a given sandbox backend ID.

methods.name: requireSandboxBackendFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory for a given ID or throws an error if not registered.
